head.t: Cold weather associated with 2,200 deaths in England last year
head.x: Cold weather was associated with 2,200 deaths in England during winter last year, a new report from the UK Health Security Agency has found. The UKHSA latest cold mortality monitoring report shows that 2,200 deaths were associated with cold weather across five cold weather episodes in 2025/26.

head.t: Five AI tools approved for identifying prostate cancer on MRI scans
head.x: Five artificial intelligence tools for more accurately detecting prostate cancer in MRI scans have been approved for use on the NHS. NICE said the tools have the potential to act like a ‘second pair of eyes’, helping radiologists review prostate MRI scans and improve accuracy and consistency of diagnosis.

head.t: PRISM: incorporating advanced imaging technologies into a comprehensive strategy for hard-to-heal wound assessment and management
head.x: Head-to-heal wounds—particularly diabetic lower-extremity wounds—remain among the most challenging and resource-intensive problems in contemporary healthcare, with five-year recurrence rates of 40–65% and a trajectory toward amputation that is frequently driven by three interacting and often under-recognised failures…

head.x: Nursing in Critical Care, Volume 31, Issue 6, November 2026.

f.t: NHS Supply Chain awards £266m infusion pump and administration set framework across 5 lots, naming 26 suppliers
f.x: NHS Supply Chain has awarded a new five-lot framework for Infusion Pumps, Administration Sets and Associated Products, covering electrical and battery-operated pumps, pump-dedicated and gravity administration sets, disposable infusion pumps and peripheral IV site monitoring devices.
